title: Implement inventory movement documents and stock costing foundation
description: Implement the next audited missing inventory batch after ERP-008: stock count/adjustment, warehouse transfer, sales return and purchase return documents with auditable stock movements and a safe inventory-cost foundation. Follow existing document conventions and validate schema changes only against NEWERP_TEST; production database/data operations remain gated.
acceptance_criteria: Stock count/adjustment, warehouse transfer, sales return and purchase return have persisted main/detail documents, numbering, CRUD, approve/unaudit rules, menus and usable web forms.
Approved documents update Stocks exactly once using auditable movement records; unaudit safely reverses the movement and rejects unsafe state transitions.
Warehouse transfer preserves total quantity while moving inventory between warehouses; returns preserve source-document traceability where a source is supplied.
Inventory costing has an explicit persisted movement-cost basis sufficient for deterministic stock valuation without retroactively mutating production data.
Schema upgrade is idempotent and is exercised only against NEWERP_TEST; no production SQL or irreversible data operation is executed.
Unit/integration tests cover quantity conservation, duplicate approval protection, reversal, insufficient stock and cost calculations; existing tests remain green.
Real Microsoft Edge acceptance covers at least one stock adjustment and one warehouse transfer end-to-end with no JS/API errors and captures screenshots.

scenarios: Login in Microsoft Edge, create a stock adjustment/count document, approve it and verify the resulting stock quantity and movement history.
Create a warehouse transfer between two warehouses, approve it and verify source decreases, destination increases and total quantity is conserved.
Unaudit a reversible test document and verify stock/movement reversal without duplicate effects.

human_gate.reason: User requested full-project completion; implementation and NEWERP_TEST validation are allowed while production database, production deployment and irreversible operations remain separately gated.
